name: W Los Angeles, West Beverly Hills
positioning: An urban retreat in the heart of Westwood, steps from UCLA and minutes from Rodeo Drive, with a heated outdoor pool, the WET Deck with cabanas and DJs, and suites with soaking tubs
best_for: Visitors to UCLA who want to stay within walking distance of campus
Travelers who want a lively pool deck with cabanas and DJs on LA's Westside

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Westwood, steps from UCLA and minutes from Rodeo Drive, Westfield Century City, Santa Monica beaches and West LA museums.
The hotel is within walking distance of UCLA.
The hotel is an urban retreat with personalized service, vibrant interiors and luxury amenities.
The WET outdoor pool is heated.
The EWOW Suite has a living room, a movie room and a private bedroom and bathroom with a rain shower and dual vanities.
Beach House is a poolside restaurant set among palms and a waterfall, serving Baja-inspired plates and craft cocktails outdoors in the shade.
The Living Room Bar has high design, inventive cocktails and remixed rhythms.
The P.A.W. pet program provides pet beds, food and water bowls, waste bags and toys.
The FIT gym has weight machines and Peloton bikes.
Santa Monica's coastline is about a 20-minute drive away.

highlights.text: The WET Deck offers private cabanas, plush sectionals, alfresco dining and rotating DJs.
The EWOW Suite has a Cinema Room with immersive surround sound and city skyline views.
Top-tier suites have deep soaking tubs.
The Whatever/Whenever service aims to get guests exactly what they want, whenever they want it.

considerations.text: Bar V by the WET Deck is open seasonally.
The minimum age to check in is 18.
WhataHotel notes the high-energy environment may not suit guests seeking quiet relaxation.
